contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

hermite_H.canonicalization: positive diagonal and reduced upper entries
hermite_H.definition: upper Hermite matrix under task convention

member_residue.definition: least nonnegative w dot member_query mod p

nonmember_residue.definition: least nonnegative w dot nonmember_query mod p

separator_vector.definition: w with w^T A=0 mod p and w nonzero mod p

representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: Let A=basis_matrix and n=rows(A). U,H are n by n integer matrices with det(U)=+1 or -1 and U*A=H.
H is upper triangular, H[i,i]>0, and for every i<j, 0<=H[i,j]<H[j,j].

member_coefficients z is an integer vector with A*z=member_query. For modulus p>1, separator w is nonzero modulo p and w^T A=0 modulo p; residues are least nonnegative values w dot query mod p and must differ.
